summary: Reading the reservation step showed that inventory reservation is guarded by Modules.LOCKING, which defaults to the in-memory provider. With two servers on one database, each process has its own lock, so two carts that each need the single SOLO unit can both be completed. Attempt 1 reproduced this: in 11 of 13 runs both carts got an order against stock 1, failing no_oversell and reserved_matches_reservations. The one-order-per-cart and no-orphan checks passed, since each order was a legitimate completion of its own cart.
